text:
Help Jacky get ready for Halloween!
You can get "Snow Mist Candy" required to
receive your reward if you help her.

You can get [ffff64]Pumpkin Cookie[ffffff] from fire element monsters,
[ffff64]Pumpkin Candy[ffffff] from light element monsters,
[ffff64]Pumpkin Soup[ffffff] from neutral monsters,
[ffff64]Jack Pudding[ffffff] from wind element monsters,
[ffff64]Barmbrack[ffffff] from earth element monsters,
[ffff64]Ginger Cake[ffffff] from water element monsters,
and [ffff64]Zombie Cake[ffffff] from dark element monsters respectively.
